entries.back_en: Wait... Thou also art one of the Eternals...?
entries.note: 'sés' deveria ser 'és'; sentido ok mas erro de conjugação.

entries.back_en: Doesn't matter! No one, even if they be brother to my master, may be allowed to enter!
entries.note: Sentido preservado; 'sejam irmão' tem leve descordo número, mas aceitável.

entries.back_en: Standing in front of a switch makes the floor light up. You can push a cube forward by pressing ~, and back by pressing [7F]. Line up three blocks of the same color to create a path.
entries.note: 'luminar' não é padrão (iluminar/acender), mas sentido claro.

entries.back_en: Ye who will walk the path, seek first the key
entries.note: Voz arcaica preservada e sentido fiel.
